Visitor.title: Visitor
Visitor.description: A unique website visitor persisted across updates, deployments, and server restarts.

SiteStats.description: Global persistent aggregate count of unique website visitors.

totalUniqueVisitors.description: Permanent all-time count of unique visitors.

visitorId.description: Associated persistent visitor identifier for deduplication.

/analytics_visitors/{visitorId}.description: Permanent deduplicated registry of unique website visitors.
